narrative.overview:
Yashoth Enterprises Scrap ERP is an authoritative, high-cadence digital ledger purpose-built for the rugged operational reality of metal recycling yards, industrial demolition projects, and weighbridge weigh-stations. The visual atmosphere unites the precision of heavy industrial engineering with the clarity of statutory double-entry accounting. It abandons delicate SaaS minimalism in favor of bold, tactile, high-contrast surfaces that remain razor-sharp under bright outdoor sunlight and grease-smudged smartphone screens.

The system serves the proprietor, weighbridge operators, and accounting staff who make continuous commercial and material decisions in seconds: recording gross truck weights, evaluating scrap cuts (HMS-1, MS Boring, Copper, Aluminum), preparing official GST EWB-01 e-Way bills, issuing 1-tap quotations, and disbursing daily wage labor.
keyCharacteristics: Yard-Hardened High Contrast: Heavy #0f172a ink on crisp #ffffff and #f8fafc surfaces guaranteed to resist midday solar washout and Android OS forced dark mode degradation.
Thumb-Driven 48px Ergonomics: Every interactive button, input field, and navigation tab honors a rigid ≥ 48px touch target requirement.
Tactile Active Feedback: Buttons depress slightly (scale(0.97)) on tap, providing mechanical affirmation without cumbersome animation lag.
Bilingual Typographic Harmony: Dense tabular numerals paired with crisp Latin typography and legible Tamil script (தமிழ்) for labour and wage clarity.
Zero-Lag Print Authority: Flawless CSS print stylesheets delivering pixel-perfect official A4 tax invoices and quotations with authentic letterhead, seals, and proprietor signatures.

rules.name: The Sunlight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Critical numerical data (Gross Weight, Tare Weight, Net Payable Weight, Rate per MT, and Total Invoice Value) must always render in #0f172a or #dc2626 over #ffffff or #f8fafc. Low-contrast grays (< 4.5:1) are strictly forbidden on financial and weight metrics.

rules.name: The Strict Light-Surface Rule
rules.body: Input fields, text areas, and select dropdowns must enforce color-scheme: light !important with a guaranteed #ffffff background and #0f172a text color so that external Android dark mode switches cannot invert form elements into unreadable low-contrast states.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: All scrap weight quantities (KG, MT) and currency values (₹) must utilize monospace tabular figures (font-feature-settings: 'tnum') to maintain strict vertical column alignment across dense financial tables.

rules.name: The Bilingual Parity Rule
rules.body: When displaying Tamil alongside English in labour, wage, or cash vouchers, both scripts must share identical typographic optical weight and vertical alignment without awkward baseline clipping.

rules.name: The Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: Primary operational actions (Record Slip, New Quote, Confirm Dispatch) must be placed in the lower half of the mobile viewport or pinned via floating sticky footers to allow effortless one-handed thumb interaction.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: All cards, tables, and form sections rest flat against the canvas. Elevation is invoked strictly to lift interactive dialogs, mobile bottom navigation, and action buttons above the document flow.

dos: Do maintain a minimum 48px by 48px touch target for all clickable buttons, selects, and navigation items.
Do ensure all form controls specify color-scheme: light !important with white backgrounds to protect against Android dark mode washout.
Do format weights (MT, KG) and currency (₹) using tabular numerals and standard Indian numbering notation (₹1,25,000.00).
Do display clear bilingual labels (Tamil + English) on daily wage, advance recovery, and labour muster rolls.
Do provide immediate active tactile feedback (scale(0.97)) on all touch actions.
donts: Don't use low-contrast text (e.g. light gray on white) for weighbridge readings, invoice values, or tax breakdowns.
Don't create touch targets smaller than 48px on mobile views.
Don't allow form input text to drop below 16px, which causes disruptive automatic zooming in mobile WebViews.
Don't introduce heavy backdrop blurs, floating shadows, or elaborate animations that introduce lag on budget Android hardware.
Don't obscure or crop official letterhead banners or proprietor seals on commercial documents.
